scientific_integrity: The discrete fourth-moment and Pell reduction are proved for all n>=4 and 1<=k<n. Finite checker output is corroboration only. The 56-point tight spherical design is an established special case, not a claimed discovery.
scientific_limitations: No sixth-order design, minimality, or unique spherical-design construction is asserted. Earlier equivalent Johnson-scheme or spherical-design statements could exist; Delsarte-Goethals-Seidel 1977 and Bannai-Bannai 2009 full text were not accessible for complete comparison.
title: Pell-classified spherical fifth-order cubature on antipodal hypersimplex orbits
